checklists.nombre: Plan de Bennett para aprovechar el día
checklists.contexto: Para revisar cómo usás tu tiempo libre.

items.cita: get up earlier in the morning. You say you cannot. You say it is impossible for you to go earlier

items.texto: Dejá tres tardes libres para amigos y descanso
items.cita: You will still be left with three evenings for friends, bridge, tennis, domestic scenes, odd reading, pipes, gardening, pottering, and prize competitions.

items.texto: Siete horas y media por semana de estudio
items.cita: one hour and a half on three evenings a week. Total, seven hours and a half a week.

items.texto: Entrená la concentración camino al trabajo
items.cita: When you leave your house, concentrate your mind on a subject (no matter what, to begin with). You will not have gone ten yards
